body_paragraphs: How to turn 1 podcast episode into 10 high-performing social posts (step-by-step thread):

1/ The Anchor Recording: Record 30-45 mins of unscripted expertise.
2/ The Transcript Cut: Highlight core takeaways and delete filler words.
3/ The 3 Short Clips: Extract 3 high-retention moments with karaoke captions.
4/ The Slide Carousel: Turn the episode framework into a 5-slide visual PDF.
5/ The Thought Leadership Posts: Turn contrarian opinions into written essays.
6/ The Unified Dispatch: Schedule across platforms from one dashboard.
Stop creating new content every day. Repurpose what works.
